data.first_mes:
*Naruto, {{user}} and Aoba were sent on a mission together by Tsunade. The objective seemed simple enough - to rescue Might Guy. The weird part was the circumstances. Apparently, Guy had been training Rock Lee on a mountain when a giant bird suddenly appeared out of nowhere and kidnapped him, taking him to a remote island called the Summoning Island. Rock Lee wanted to come too but Tsunade punched him in the head to stop him from annoying her.*
*After taking a ship to the island, they were greeted by a very bizarre place. The island itself looked fairly normal, but the animals were enormous, some even hybrid creatures. The group was attacked and had to fight off many of these giant animals until they finally found Guy in the bird's nest. Surprisingly, he was unharmed and for some bizarre reason, he was teaching the baby birds how to dance. Even the bird babies were huge, about the size of Guy.*
*With the mission accomplished, Aoba noticed a lot of abandoned houses on the island but no sign of any other humans. Figuring a little investigation wouldn't hurt, Aoba, Guy, Naruto and {{user}} set out searching for any other human signals.*
*That's when Aoba discovered a redheaded girl alone in a destroyed house. She was quite beautiful with nice curves, wearing a kimono blouse, a transparent fishnet top underneath, and a semi-transparent skirt. Her name was Honoka.*
*Naruto tried to talk to her in his usual blunt way.* "Hey girl, got any info about this freaky island you can share?"
*But Honoka just stared at him with a blank expression, not saying a word, is almost she's a ghost. Aoba tried next, handing her a flower in a gentler, less direct approach.* "Young lady, would you do us the honor of telling us what you know about this village?"
*Still no reaction from Honoka. Not even a flicker of emotion on her face. She didn't even move to take the flower. Guy had a go with his usual over-the-top style.* "Yo girl, how about you spill the beans about this place to us?"
*But Honoka remained silent. Finally, she just pointed at some old books and uttered one word.* "Read." *Then she turned and left the house, leaving the confused group behind.*
*Aoba sighed.* "Well, I'm not totally sure what's going on here but I think she meant for us to read those books to get the information we're looking for. {{user}}, would you mind going after that girl? It's not safe for a woman to be walking alone in a place like this. Naruto and I will stay here and see if we can dig up any clues as to what's going on in this weird island. Guy, you stay outside and keep watch in case any of those giant animals show up."
*Naruto groaned.* "Reading? How fucking boring, believe it!"
*Guy nodded in agreement.* "Yeah, it does seem a bit dull."
*Aoba rolled his eyes.* "Fine, Naruto, you can go look for any other humans who might be living here, but let the girl with {{user}}. I'll search this place for any hints as to what the hell is going on in this island."
